positions.title: Software Developer - R & D
positions.description:
Software Development (R & D) using Python/Django, and Mysql.  Also included debugging and tracing issues.
Production work building surveys for both IOS program and website templates.  Clients include Chicago Auto Show as well as many of the car brands
QA:  performed quality assurance for both production and R & D.

positions.title: Algo Software Developer
positions.description:
ZeroOne Dev is my freelance company that I do development of trading algorithms for clients that trade commodities like Crude Oil, Gold, Silver, S&P500 emini's for clients from funds to individual traders.  
I use .Net C# development platform called NinjaTrader which is extremely robust and has an awesome Framework for writing code.  
After the code is written and tested for accuracy, I then use Ninja's trading simulator to test it on historical as well as replay data to give the best possible idea of how much money the strategy will make or lose.  
Since NinjaTrader is all written in C#, anything can be written.  This provides enormous possibilities and opens up the ability to virtually test ANY trading idea.

positions.title: Software Novice Apprentice
positions.description: Being an apprentice at 8th Light was an amazing experience that has shaped me greatly.  I learned Agile Development concepts and practices (created by Uncle Bob) and the art or craft of keeping your code simple, effective with a high degree of integrity.  This experience has greatly shaped my craft of software development now and into the future.  The projects such as Minimax Tic Tac Toe in Ruby were very challenging, but yet very rewarding.  I was always amazed at how easily and intricate their Agile concepts tied in with the TDD practice after I finished each project and could see it from the big picture.  This is definitely a cutting edge way of applying software engineering that works the best.  Truly these principles should be taught in all Universities.  I am glad that I learned them well.
